description:
BR06 is an advanced GPS tracking device developed to provide reliable real time vehicle monitoring and improved fleet management capabilities. Designed with modern telematics technology, the device combines GPS positioning and cellular communication to deliver accurate location tracking and operational alerts for vehicles.

The device receives positioning signals from GPS satellites to determine the vehicle's exact location. This location data is then transmitted to a monitoring platform through cellular connectivity. Fleet operators and vehicle owners can access this information through web dashboards or mobile applications that display vehicle movement on interactive digital maps.

Real time vehicle tracking enables businesses to maintain complete visibility of their fleet operations. Companies can monitor vehicle locations, track delivery progress and respond quickly to operational changes. This feature is particularly valuable for logistics companies, delivery services and transportation businesses that depend on timely and efficient vehicle operations.

BR06 also includes intelligent monitoring features that enhance vehicle safety and operational control. Ignition detection allows the system to identify when the vehicle engine is turned on or off. Fleet managers can use this feature to monitor driver activity, track operational hours and verify vehicle usage.

Geo fence monitoring allows users to define virtual boundaries around specific operational areas such as warehouses, service zones or delivery routes. When a vehicle enters or leaves these zones, the system automatically sends alerts to the monitoring platform. This feature helps organizations prevent unauthorized vehicle usage and maintain better operational control.

The device also supports overspeed alerts. When a vehicle exceeds a predefined speed limit, the system generates a notification to the monitoring platform. This capability helps fleet operators enforce safe driving practices and reduce accident risks.

Another useful capability of BR06 is trip history recording. The system stores route information which can later be reviewed through route playback features in the tracking platform. Fleet managers can analyze driving patterns, optimize routes and improve fleet efficiency.

The compact design of the BR06 tracker allows it to be installed discreetly inside vehicles without affecting normal vehicle operation. Built using durable automotive grade materials, the device is capable of operating reliably under typical vehicle conditions including vibration, temperature fluctuations and continuous movement.

BR06 is widely used across industries including logistics fleets, transportation services, delivery vehicles and commercial fleet management systems. It also provides an effective solution for personal vehicle security and monitoring.

By combining real time GPS tracking with intelligent alerts and trip analysis features, BR06 helps businesses improve operational efficiency, enhance safety and maintain better control over their fleet operations.

description:
The V5 Mini Vehicle GPS Tracker is a compact and versatile vehicle tracking device designed for real-time location monitoring, vehicle security, and driver behaviour analysis. With support for a wide operating voltage range of DC 9–90V, the device is compatible with a wide range of vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, trucks, buses, commercial vehicles, and other powered assets.

Featuring built-in GPS positioning and 2G GSM/GPRS communication, the V5 enables reliable vehicle location tracking and data transmission. Its compact design and integrated antenna allow for discreet installation, making it suitable for hidden installation inside vehicles. The device continuously monitors vehicle movement and can generate alerts for vehicle movement, speeding, geofence violations, and other predefined events.

The V5 supports ACC detection through wired ignition monitoring and motion-based ignition detection. This enables the tracking system to identify vehicle ignition and movement status. The device also supports remote cut-off functionality, allowing authorized users to remotely disable the vehicle's power or fuel supply through the connected fleet management platform, subject to proper vehicle installation and system configuration.

With an integrated accelerometer, the tracker supports driver behaviour analysis, including harsh acceleration, harsh braking, and rash turning detection. These insights help fleet operators improve driving standards, reduce unsafe driving behaviour, and enhance overall vehicle safety.

The device includes multiple alert functions for enhanced security and fleet monitoring. Alerts can be configured for vehicle movement, speeding, geofence events, and other operational conditions. The V5 also features a built-in rechargeable 60mAh / 3.7V Li-Polymer battery, providing backup power during power interruptions or vehicle tampering situations.

The tracker supports 1000 offline memory logs, allowing tracking data to be stored when cellular connectivity is temporarily unavailable. Once communication is restored, stored data can be transmitted to the tracking platform. Its 2G GSM connectivity supports GSM 850/900/1800/1900 MHz bands, while GPRS Class 12 and TCP/IP communication enable data transmission to compatible GPS tracking platforms.

The V5 Mini Vehicle GPS Tracker is suitable for personal vehicles, fleet management, logistics, commercial transportation, vehicle security, driver monitoring, and asset tracking applications. Its compact size, wide voltage compatibility, low power consumption, and reliable tracking features make it an efficient solution for vehicle monitoring and anti-theft applications.

description:
The PRITHVI 140 is an advanced AIS-140 compliant Vehicle Location Tracking Device (VLTD) developed by Watsoo Express Pvt. Ltd. It supports GSM, GPS, GNSS, and IRNSS (NavIC) for accurate real-time vehicle tracking. Featuring an embedded dual-network SIM, SOS emergency button, fuel monitoring, anti-theft alerts, and IP67-rated protection, it is ideal for fleet management, commercial transportation, and Smart City projects.

Certified under AIS-140 and ARAI standards, the device is engineered for rigorous public transport, commercial fleet monitoring, school buses, and smart city infrastructure. It combines high-sensitivity GNSS with Indian satellite IRNSS (NavIC) constellation for reliable geonavigation even in urban canyons and remote corridors.
